findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "edit_formula" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_formula · Private data: create_formula, add_to_shelf, update_bottle, make_dilution, delete_items, confirm_delete · Public sink: edit_formula, view_accord · Destructive: edit_formula, shopping_list, delete_items, confirm_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_formula · Private data: create_formula, add_to_shelf, update_bottle, make_dilution, delete_items, confirm_delete · Public sink: edit_formula, view_accord · Destructive: edit_formula, shopping_list, delete_items, confirm_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
